title: Gods, Rich-Men, Angels: Three Discrete Degrees of Divine Emanation
description: Why three names are spoken in the cosmos for divine beings. Each name marks a distinct station in the descent of Divine Truth: gods (called by the Father directly, of the celestial Greatness); rich-men (called by the gods, of the spiritual Beloved of Lights); angels (called by the rich, sent on embassy to the cosmos through the Ambassador). Discrete-degree emanation: each lower order is constituted by the summoning act of the order above.
